spans.s: लघय् vt. (denom. pres. लघयति) 1. To make light, नितांतागुर्वीं लघयिष्यता धुरम् R.iii.35; 2. to lessen, to diminish, to mitigate; 3. to bring low, to make inferior, Kir.v.4.

लघिमन् m. 1. Lightness, absence of weight; 2. insignificance, smallness; 3. lowness, meanness, Bt.iii.7; 4. the power of assuming excessive lightness at will, considered as one of the eight supernatural faculties.
लघिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Very light, lightest, (super. of लघु q.v.)
लघिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Very light, lightest, (super. of लघु q.v.)
लघीयस् a. (f. सी) More light, lighter, (compar. of लघु q.v.).
लघीयस् a. (f. सी) More light, lighter, (compar. of लघु q.v.).

लघु (I) a. (f. घु or घ्वी) 1. Quick, swift, nimble, संहारविक्षेपलघुक्रियेण R.v.45, Megh.i.16; 2. light, not heavy, विषाणपरिमोक्षलघूत्तमांगान् R.ix.62, रिक्तः सर्वो भवति हि लघुः पूर्णता गौरवाय Megh.i.20; 3. easy, not difficult, R.xii.66; 4. easy of digestion; 5. small, little, diminutive, Sis.ix.38; 6. trifling, trivial, unimportant; 7. mean, contemptible, low; 8. soft, gentle; 9. young; 10. beautiful, handsome; 11. pure, clean; 12. short (as a vowel) (in prosody); 13. agreeable, pleasant, दर्शनेन लघुना यथा तयोः R.xi.12, 80; 14. brief, लघुसंदेशपदा सरस्वती R.viii.77.(In many of these senses, लघु is also used as an indeclinable. लघुलघु ind. ‘very early.’)
लघु (II) n. 1. Agallochum; 2. a particular measure of time.

लघु (I) a. (f. घु or घ्वी) 1. Quick, swift, nimble, संहारविक्षेपलघुक्रियेण R.v.45, Megh.i.16; 2. light, not heavy, विषाणपरिमोक्षलघूत्तमांगान् R.ix.62, रिक्तः सर्वो भवति हि लघुः पूर्णता गौरवाय Megh.i.20; 3. easy, not difficult, R.xii.66; 4. easy of digestion; 5. small, little, diminutive, Sis.ix.38; 6. trifling, trivial, unimportant; 7. mean, contemptible, low; 8. soft, gentle; 9. young; 10. beautiful, handsome; 11. pure, clean; 12. short (as a vowel) (in prosody); 13. agreeable, pleasant, दर्शनेन लघुना यथा तयोः R.xi.12, 80; 14. brief, लघुसंदेशपदा सरस्वती R.viii.77.(In many of these senses, लघु is also used as an indeclinable. लघुलघु ind. ‘very early.’)
लघ्वी f. 1. A delicate woman; 2. a light carriage.
लघु-आशिन्, -आहार a. eating little, moderate in diet.
लघु-आशिन्, -आहार a. eating little, moderate in diet.
लघु-उक्ति f. a brief mode of expression.
लघु-उत्थान, -समुत्थान a. doing work rapidly.
लघु-उत्थान, -समुत्थान a. doing work rapidly.
लघु-काय (I) a. light-bodied.
लघु-काय (II) m. a goat.
लघु-क्रम a. having a rapid step, going quickly.
लघु-खट्विका f. a small bedstead.
लघु-गोधूम m. a small kind of wheat.
लघु-चित्त, -चेतस् a. light-minded, fickle, unsteady.
लघु-चित्त, -चेतस् a. light-minded, fickle, unsteady.
लघु-जंगल m. a kind of quail.
लघु-ता f. 1. agility, activity, quickness; 2. shortness, brevity; 3. littleness, smallness; 4. ease, facility; 5. frivolity; 6. wantonness; 7. want of dignity.
लघु-त्व n. 1. agility, activity, quickness; 2. shortness, brevity; 3. littleness, smallness; 4. ease, facility; 5. frivolity; 6. wantonness; 7. want of dignity.
लघु-द्राक्षा f. a small stoneless grape.
लघु-पाक a. easily digested.
लघु-पुष्प m. a kind of kadamba.
लघु-प्रयत्न a. pronounced with slight articulation (as a letter).
लघु-बदर m. a kind of jujube.
लघु-बदरी f. a kind of jujube.
लघु-भव m. humble birth.
लघु-भोजन n. a light repast.
लघु-मांस m. a kind of partridge.
लघु-मूलक n. a radish.
लघु-लय n. agallochum.
लघु-विक्रम a. having a quick step, hastening.
लघु-वृत्ति a. 1. light, frivolous; 2. low, vile, badly behaved; 3. mismanaged.
लघु-वेधिन् a. cleverly hitting.
लघु-हस्त (I) a. active, nimble, expert.
लघु-हस्त (II) m. a good archer.
लाघ् vi. 1Ā (pres. लाघते) To be equal to, to be competent.

लाघव n. 1. Quickness, speed, rapidity; 2. activity, versatility, readiness; 3. smallness, littleness; 4. insignificance; 5. frivolity, levity, lightness; 6. ease, facility; 7. brevity, conciseness; 8. slight, disrespect, contempt, येषां च त्वं बहुमतो नूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम् Bg.ii.35; 9. shortness of a syllable (in prosody).
